Progressive guide

Learning control through geometry and optimization

Build from an installed CSL consumer to set representations, controllers, supporting operations, and source-bound environment examples. Every claim names its mathematical scope and evidence role.

Start here

  1. Ready · installed consumer Start with an installed consumer

    Install and validate the package before studying algorithms. The example resolves its public target through the package and checks the returned answer.

  2. Ready · analytic illustration Name coordinates and outcomes

    The requested flow-mass projections are oxidizer (2,100) and fuel (0.6,30). Undo scaling before reordering scaled coordinates. An observed policy path is not the set of all admissible controls. A soft objective target is not a hard target region.

1. Vertex LP and simplex methods

  1. Ready · installed consumer Use LP membership to remove redundant vertices

    The midpoint is a convex combination of opposite corners. Removing it leaves the unit square unchanged. Membership decisions use the registered numerical LP and specified bounded checks. Resource stops and incomplete outcomes must remain visible.

  2. Ready · installed consumers Compare source-index hull methods in a 2D operation

    Check every input point, including interior points, edge points, and duplicates. KPABEP/MODIF preserve source order, pivots, epsilon, and stops. QuickHull is a distinct modern comparator. Saved timings do not imply a general speedup.

  3. Ready · installed consumer Keep terminal optimization separate from membership

    A Strategy A linear terminal program returns the complete minimum-cost segment. A separate convex residual-norm terminal program returns one numerical minimizer. Neither result is a vertex membership decision.

2. Reachable-set representations

  1. Ready · analytic illustration Compare five set representations on one square

    This analytic calculation compares H/V polytopes, zonotopes, parallelotopes, ellipsoids and boxes on one square. Its Python script does not invoke CSL APIs.

  2. Ready · installed consumers Run the installed set approximation consumers

    Installed clients execute the public box, parallelotope, zonotope-reduction, and ellipsoid APIs on declared inputs. The box and parallelotope clients use the same diamond; the two other clients use their own specified sets.

3. Reachable-set controllers and MPC

  1. Ready · analytic illustration Read a closed-loop policy trace

    Separate predicted stage coordinates from observed execution state and label the observation update. A deterministic replay is one trajectory. It is not full forward reachability or a nonlinear enclosure.

  2. Ready · installed consumers Run finite feedback and minimax consumers

    Two installed clients execute finite feedback and finite causal minimax ports on small declared action tables.

  3. Ready · installed package example Compose reachability, recovery, and MPC

    The complete optimal joint family is (x0,x1,x2,u0,u1)=(0,s,1,s,1-s), 0<=s<=1. The exact-family verifier applies only to its registered profiles. Generic Strategy A/B paths are numerical candidates. Local NLP MPC makes no global optimum claim.

4. Conversions, set operations, approximations and optimization

  1. Ready · installed consumers Convert, map, sum, intersect, and project sets

    Four installed consumers convert the unit square, sum unit intervals, intersect scalar half-spaces, and compute a nominal predecessor. The results are the unit square, [0,2], [0,1], and [1,3], respectively.

  2. Ready · installed consumer Select the optimization role you need

    An LP returns one optimizer; a membership query returns a predicate; finite minimax is scoped to its finite table. HiGHS is optional. Numerical solver output is not a certificate unless a separate verifier says so.

Environment capstones

  1. Ready · saved execution evidence Capstone: Lotka–Volterra populations

    Plot P against R from saved execution states. Keep plant replay and prediction stages distinct. This is one local-NLP policy path. Native module substitution rows remain pending until #943; every bypassed module must read not_used.

  2. Ready · saved execution evidence Capstone: Earth orbit

    Plot r against v for the recorded execution states. The target radius and rate remain soft objective terms. The finite nine-action three-block source task differs from this continuous per-interval domain. Native substitutions await #943.

  3. Ready · saved execution evidence Capstone: fuel transfer

    The flow coordinate precedes mass on both axes. Unscale only when the raw source coordinates are scaled. Do not conflate absolute propellant mass with the older stock-balance example. The pilot is one local-NLP path. Native substitutions await #943.

  4. Pending · native comparison capture not published Pending: compare native modules on fixed tasks

    The observed-state CSL pilot is published for all three fixed tasks. Module substitutions using the captured native 30-batch policy comparisons remain pending until issue #943 is published.
